{"notes": "VISIT 4 (left at 6:00). I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm not crediting or blaming anyone for the physical build.

Table: The earlier gap at the belly/tail joint is now closed. The top line, head, belly and lower tail fork all show as connected to the start, so the main outline would fall. Remaining problem: the upper tail fin (from about (22.8, 8.3) up to (27, 4)) is still pale and disconnected, roughly 10 dominoes. Next visit: confirm that last link is made and the fin is chained on. I can't tell who fixed the joint, so I won't credit anyone for it.

Priya: Kept leading. She told Leo to hold off, said her stroke would do the bridge, and asked Tom to check her/Maya's joint. Clear and collaborative, but her message and Leo's overlapped, and her earlier 'everything connected' claim was wrong. Ask who owns the upper tail fin.

Leo: Responded promptly and cooperatively, agreeing to meet Priya at the join and nudge his last dominoes into line. Nudging placed dominoes near a live chain is a risk, though it worked out. Ask him to confirm the head joints and what he plans for the tail fin.

Tom: Still no reply or visible follow-up on Priya's second request to check the joint. Earlier proactivity was good, but this visit gave me nothing to rate. Ask directly what he checked.

Maya: Not seen or heard this visit. Earlier handoff was reliable. No new evidence; ask whether she is helping with the fin."}
